profile.description: Active two-day community car show with live music, contests, vendors and family activities.

notes.subject: 2026 budget and footprint objection
notes.body: The committee replied Aug. 4, 2026 that it did not know whether it had enough space for Adventure Zone and could not afford the stated fees. Current official information confirms Joe Mama's remains an active community car show; 2026 ran Aug. 14-15 at Founders Park and accepted vendors. This was a budget/space objection, not a permanent rejection. If revisited, do not simply repeat a prepaid-price pitch; first verify available footprint and whether a pay-for-play entertainment partnership is feasible.

followUps.label: Review 2027 Joe Mama's Car Show fit
followUps.reason: 2026 objection was budget plus space. Check the 2027 layout and whether a pay-for-play setup could work before deciding to contact them again.
